name: Sylwia Krzasińska
original_name: シルヴィア・クシャシンスカ
source:
Leutnant (2nd LT) Sylwia Krzasińska is a former Polish national. She has a cold attitude and is efficient in her piloting. Her Callsign is Schwarzesmarken 05.

[From [url=http://muvluv.wikia.com/wiki/Sylwia_Krzasińska]Muv-Luv Wiki[/url]]
